title: COMPUTATIONAL ASPECTS OF ROBOTICS
description: Introduction to fundamental problems and algorithms in robotics. Topics include configuration spaces, motion and sensor models, search and sampling-based planning, state estimation, localization and mapping, perception, and learning.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( COMS W3134 or COMS W3136 or COMS W3137 ) and ( COMS W3251 or MATH UN2010 or APMA E2101 or APMA E3101 or MATH UN2015 ) and ( STAT GU4001 or IEOR E3658 or STAT UN1201 or MATH UN2015 ) Proficiency in Python or a similar programming language.
notes_text: CC/GS: Partial Fulfillment of Science Requirement
